summary: A Shrewsbury sniper rifle that only goes on sale after finishing Bret Vogel's ninth hunting job.
body: PowerPyx lists it at $2,150 at Expanded Ammu-Nation stores and says it unlocks after Bret Vogel's ninth hunting quest, a questline that begins with the optional Chapter 2 mission Veteran Hunted.
It does not appear in DayOne's weapon list, so its calibre and ratings are unverified.

facts.availability: Expanded Ammu-Nation stores (Woodhatch, Big Shots, Phil's Ammu-Nation, Black Eagle, Iron & Oak, Prestige Firearms) after Bret Vogel's ninth hunting quest

name: Goodwin LMG 6
summary: A Goodwin light machine gun in 7.62x51mm fed from a 100-round supply.
body: DayOne lists in-game ratings out of 10 of damage 6.8, accuracy 2.8, handling 2.8 and range 6.5, with a capacity of 100 rounds and full auto fire.
PowerPyx says Expanded Ammu-Nation stores are the ones that stock light machine guns, without naming the models.

name: ADB M350
summary: A 5.56mm light machine gun from Armurerie de Belgique (AdB) with a 100-round supply.
body: DayOne lists in-game ratings out of 10 of damage 6.5, accuracy 3.0, handling 3.2 and range 6.2, with a capacity of 100 rounds and full auto fire.
PowerPyx says Expanded Ammu-Nation stores are the ones that stock light machine guns, without naming the models.

name: Hillinger Boomer
summary: A single-shot military 40mm grenade launcher made by Hillinger.
body: DayOne lists in-game ratings out of 10 of damage 9.2, accuracy 5.0, handling 6.0 and range 4.0, with a capacity of 1 rounds and single shot fire.
PowerPyx calls it the Hillinger Boomer and prices it at $12,000 at Expanded Ammu-Nation stores; DayOne writes the name as Hillinger Boomers.

facts.availability: Expanded Ammu-Nation stores (Woodhatch, Big Shots, Phil's Ammu-Nation, Black Eagle, Iron & Oak, Prestige Firearms)

summary: A six-shot rotary 40mm grenade launcher made by Deever Tech.

PowerPyx prices it at $15,500 at Expanded Ammu-Nation stores.

facts.availability: Expanded Ammu-Nation stores (Woodhatch, Big Shots, Phil's Ammu-Nation, Black Eagle, Iron & Oak, Prestige Firearms)

name: Hauners H-AT
summary: A single-shot shoulder-fired 66mm rocket launcher from Hauners Industries, strong against vehicles.
body: DayOne lists in-game ratings out of 10 of damage 9.6, accuracy 4.5, handling 3.0 and range 8.0, with a capacity of 1 rounds and single shot fire.
PowerPyx calls it the Hauners H-AT Rocket Launcher, the game's only rocket launcher, priced at $16,000 at Expanded Ammu-Nation stores; DayOne lists it simply as H-AT.
PowerPyx also lists a cheat that adds a Hauners H-AT to the loadout.

facts.availability: Expanded Ammu-Nation stores (Woodhatch, Big Shots, Phil's Ammu-Nation, Black Eagle, Iron & Oak, Prestige Firearms)

name: Killtelligence SM-69
summary: A one-of-a-kind hunting variant of the SM-69 rifle that Bret gives the player.
body: PowerPyx says Bret hands it over at the start of the optional mission Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) and counts it as a Unique Weapon Variant.
PowerPyx adds that it can be collected again from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Insider Gaming says unique weapons carry a gold icon and cannot be modified.

facts.availability: Given by Bret in Veteran Hunted; afterwards in any weapon locker

name: Gutterball Moreland 850
summary: A unique variant of the Moreland 850 shotgun found inside Kingpin Bowling.
body: PowerPyx says it lies on a table in the north-east corner of the bowling alley, is marked with a gold icon, and is one of three key valuables for the Let's Go Bowling trophy.

facts.availability: Found at Kingpin Bowling during the optional job Hit Kingpin Bowling

name: Duval Signature ES9
summary: Jason's engraved Ultimate Edition variant of the Girardi ES9 pistol.
body: Cultured Vultures says it is available from Chapter 1 in the Ammu-Nation weapon locker, under the ES9's Variants option, and cannot be customised or upgraded.
PowerPyx likewise says it is redeemed from a weapon locker at Ammu-Nation.
Cultured Vultures says either lead can use the other's signature pistol.

facts.availability: Ultimate Edition; Ammu-Nation weapon locker from Chapter 1

name: Caminos Signature K17
summary: Lucia's engraved Ultimate Edition variant of the Klose K17 pistol.
body: Cultured Vultures says it unlocks in Chapter 2, roughly 10 to 15 hours in, and is taken from the Ammu-Nation weapon locker under the K17's Variants option.
PowerPyx likewise says it is redeemed from a weapon locker at Ammu-Nation.
Cultured Vultures says it cannot be customised or upgraded.

facts.availability: Ultimate Edition; Ammu-Nation weapon locker from Chapter 2

name: Sticky Bombs
summary: Plantable explosives sold at Ammu-Nation and used to blow open safes and armoured truck doors.
body: PowerPyx advises buying them at Ammu-Nation before robbing Kingpin Bowling, where they destroy the office safe.
PowerPyx also describes using them on shop back-room safes and on the rear door of an armoured truck, and says some are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.

name: Binoculars
summary: Used to scout distant targets such as enemies and robbery sites, and to study animals from afar.
body: PowerPyx says they are picked from the weapon wheel and used to study animals for the 100% checklist.

name: Flashlight
summary: A hand torch for lighting dark places; it is not a weapon.

name: Duffel Bag
summary: A bag for hauling valuables such as marked bills, jewellery and drugs to a drop-off.

name: Headphones
summary: Let the player listen to radio, playlists and podcasts while on foot.
body: DayOne says they are sold at electronics shops.

name: Pry Bar
summary: Opens sealed crates, which can raise the take on some robberies.

name: Masks
summary: Worn to hide the face from police during crimes.
body: DayOne notes the mask should come off again once out of sight.

name: Metal Detector
summary: Finds metal objects at short range, including underwater, for Kenton's treasure hunts.
body: PowerPyx says it is used while diving to dig up treasure in Kenton's questline.

name: Slim Jim
summary: A tool for quietly getting into locked vehicles; quieter than force but slower.

name: Snap Gun
summary: A mechanical lockpick that opens locked doors quietly without setting off alarms.
body: PowerPyx says it is unlocked through Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, stays in the inventory permanently and is used to rob a jewellery store unseen.

name: Cut-Off Tool
summary: A small handheld cutter for the locks on heavy-duty containers and certain vehicles; effective but loud.

name: Key Cloner
summary: A phone app that defeats keyless-entry security so high-end cars can be stolen.
body: PowerPyx says it is given automatically at the start of the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS and is installed on the phone rather than bought.

facts.availability: Story unlock in Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Chapter 3)

name: Dye Pack Jammer
summary: Automatically disables exploding dye packs, which is needed for robbing banks and payday loan stores.
body: PowerPyx says it is unlocked by the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check and allows marked bills to be fenced.

name: Body Armor
summary: A bulletproof vest that adds a blue bar above health and soaks up gunfire until it is used up.
body: PowerPyx says it is sold in the Equipment section at Ammu-Nation and switched on from the item wheel.
PowerPyx also lists a cheat that adds body armor.
Insider Gaming says body armor bought at Ammu-Nation is delivered to the trunk of an owned car.

name: Parachute
summary: A hidden pack that can be opened during long falls from aircraft or buildings.
body: PowerPyx says it is sold in the Equipment section at Ammu-Nation and shares an item-wheel slot with body armor.
PowerPyx also lists a cheat that adds a parachute.
